card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long, rare words, such as Angio- in angioedema or angiotensin, GLP-1 terms, and Slavic or Georgian proper names. It fires where the word is unfinished and more letters must follow.

modes.label: Angio- and angiotensin words
modes.description: Middle pieces of medical words that start with Angi- or Angio-.

modes.label: GLP-1 and peptide terms
modes.description: Pieces of glucagon-like peptide or GLP-1 receptor agonist names.

modes.label: Foreign proper names
modes.description: Middle pieces of company or institution names from Czech, Georgian or Russian text.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long unusual words, such as angioedema or foreign names, before the word is finished.
